verdict.rationale: Gitea's own materials say it offers audit logging as a security feature, and the about.gitea.com feature list includes "Audit Logs". These are only bare mentions. Nothing describes which user or administrative actions are recorded, or how a devops-lead would view, search, filter or export the log. The listing next to SAML SSO and autoscaling runners hints it may be a paid or enterprise tier rather than core Gitea. Missing for 10: documentation of what user/admin actions are captured, a described review interface (UI/API, search, filter, export), clarity on which edition includes it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can review an audit log of user and administrative actions

citations.quote: offering features such as user permission management, access control lists, audit logging, and more to ensure the security of code and data.
